standard_prerequisites.name: Essential surjectivity criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Fully faithful plus locally essential surjectivity gives essential surjectivity.

core_obligations: s and t are smooth: transfer smoothness of f through the equivalence and presheaf-correspondence lemmas.

Essential surjectivity input: for any scheme T and object a of X_T, f smooth surjective produces a smooth surjective T' -> T with a|_{T'} coming from an object of [U/R]_{T'} (covering definition of surjective smooth).
f_can is fully faithful (part (6) of the presentation machinery); descent data are effective on both sides, so the Stacks criterion gives essential surjectivity, hence f_can is an equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Smoothness transfer; covering input; fully-faithful-plus-descent essential surjectivity.
difficulty_reason: A two-part argument: smoothness transfer and the essential-surjectivity chain via fully faithfulness plus descent.
